leadauth.return.title: Return to ProjectLead
leadauth.return.body: ProjectLead did not open by itself. Close this page and return to the app; if you are not signed in, tap “Continue with Google” again. If this keeps happening: update the app (App Store or Google Play), or tap “Forgot password?”.
leadauth.return.android: You can also allow ProjectLead to open its links: Settings > Apps > ProjectLead > Open by default.
leadauth.return.nothing: Didn't request anything in the ProjectLead app? Just close this page.
